reviews.x: These gel brushes works great with builder gel.. it's  nice to also get different  sizes to  have more options  when  working

Usually brushes that have caps push the bristles down when you close them but these don't. Also the bristles are tightly in place. I'm a happy camper. A few had a few stray bristles but nothing a good nipper won't cure.

I'm in no way a nail professional, however these brushes are junk when trying to use with builder gel. If you can buy cheap from China, wait the 20 years for them to be delivered. At least you get what you pay for. I paid $8 so not worth it! I winded up buying new brushes from Alpha Brushes they were $5 a piece but works way better then these.

reviews.t: DO NOT BUY!!!!! They fall apart!
reviews.x: These brushes are awful. #DONOTBUYTHEM! Mine fell apart DURING first use!!!!! Delivery time was excellent and package was encouraging. However I, as a nail art technician, do not have the money to constantly replace my tools. There is no question that ALL of the brushes (yes all) were completely unreliable.

These brushes are great! They have tops that pop off, but dont be mad...they are supposed to do that, you can glue them if desired but otherwise they work well! Great as clean up brushes around the nail and come in great sturdy sizes! Shipped within two days! Perfect for price and good quality!

Good product. Comes as described. Only issue is the detachable bases are a bit loose so its hard to actually use them when fully assembled as they tend to fall off while in use. I bought them for their ability to be the half size, though, so this doesn't bother me too much.

Great quality brushes for a great price.  You can pull the shaft off and put it over the brush to protect your used brushes.  I used this with the IBD gel, and it spreads quickly and easily.  The brushes cleaned up easily with nail polish remover.

We love them!!!!  I first bought it for myself. It was so great that all my  professional friends at the salon asked me to buy for them too. I have bought at least 4 sets already.  We usually buys the uv brush at nail supply stores. They cost $12-$15 for ONE brush! So this is such a great deal right here.  Works amazingly with uv nails, gel colors and nail art! Love love love!

reviews.t: I can state that I love them. They are great for using with gel ...
reviews.x: I ordered 2 sets of these brushes and now after using them more often, I can state that I love them.  They are great for using with gel product and clean up super well with alcohol.

reviews.t: I was able to glue them back together with a glue gun though and they work great.
reviews.x: These brushes are very cute but a couple of mine detached on the wrong part. I was able to glue them back together with a glue gun though and they work great.
Broke quickly... did not work on acrylic products. Disappointed.
I'm a nail tech and these are worth every penny.

reviews.t: If your looking for the caps to come on and off without the use of pliers these are not for you
reviews.x: Ok I guess the brushes are okay but I haven't used them much considering the stupid metal lids you must literally pry off with pliers. Then you must adjust each lid so that it wil actually function without the use of my boyfriends tools. They caps were a major selling point for me, if only I knew I would have to preform surgery on each brush to get the cap to come off and on smoothly I wouldn't have bothered making this purchase.

I love these! Very affordable compared to going to the cosmo store. I'm sure you could probably use these with acrylic I'll give it a try on my next set. But they work amazing with the gel! I'm in love with these  UPDATE!!!! I used them with acrylic and they work just fine just make sure you clean them properly other wise the acrylic will stick in the bristles

reviews.t: Great brush set and it works well with builder gel ...
reviews.x: Great brush set and it works well with builder gel application. The materials used to make these brushes are professional. What I like the most about them is the fact that they come with caps to protect your brushes and keep them looking like new. Very pleased with my purchase.

reviews.t: Great brushes but might come apart!
reviews.x: These are beautiful brushes that seen like they are good quality.  The only reason I'm giving it a 3 is because one of my brushes came apart as soon as i took it out of the package but it's nothing a little super glue can't fix. Otherwise they're great.
All of them fell apart where the wooden handle is attached to the metal insert. (Not the part that is supposed to detach.)
I am a licensed manicurist I have been using these brushes for months now and they work really well very happy !
They are very stiff and not very easy to use :( it’s a shame because they look so cool and sleek
Great product! Very comfortable to use in different sizes,good quality.will recommend to anyone.
I really like the feel of the brush. Easy to use and cleans up well.
FAST SHIPPING....Nice quality brushes...would purchase again!
Brush that I got was nice just only received one not the set

These are very nice, they look so professional. They work very well and you dont have to worry that they will be damaged when not in use because they have the detachable lid. I have used other brushes that cost twice as much then these but you are only given one brush with other companies, with this pack you get 6 brushes which is was more affortable. I am not a professinal nail tech I just do my nails at home and for friends, but these brushes look so cute even for home use.

They are ok but I'm just learning how to do nails. A couple of the tops don't fit but that doesn't bother me much. I only use two which were the 6 and 8, the acrylic get stuck in the brush fast bit other that they work pretty good. It could be that since I'm just starting off I'm not cleaning then or brushing them off enough when doing my nails. For $8 they are not bad brushes especially when you are a beginner like myself

claims.text: Many reviewers say these brushes work well with gel and builder gel.
Several reviewers praise the value and low price compared to salon-supply brushes.
Some reviewers report brushes falling apart or detaching during use.
Reviewers are divided on the caps: some like that they protect bristles, while others find them loose or hard to remove.
A few reviewers mention stray bristles or poor performance with acrylic.
